arms.B: Independent planner instruction override, no dependencies or assessment
arms.C: Production planner and dependency binding, no sufficiency assessment/actions during answer
arms.D: Unchanged production planned controller; reuse final matched outputs once, declared before other arm results

shadow: C frozen final context assessed once after all its answers; never act on proposals. Same production assessor as D; final C evidence and answer remain frozen.
fixed: Same six-file index, file scopes, question text, parser, embeddings, reranker, top_k=5, context=4096 and base final-answer prompt. D additionally supplies assessment guidance, which is part of that component; the base answer instructions are not changed.
order: Matched D batch then case-major A/B/C, then shadow C. Sequential; cache/time order effects not isolated.
rubric: Original six-case reference point/claim review and synthetic dependency protocol. No aggregate superiority requirement: report all improvements, regressions, extra calls, tokens and latency. B/C are comparisons, not claims that every arm must pass every question.
limits: Four diagnostic development cases, including one explicitly synthetic controller case. One sample per arm. Not a statistical generalization or equal-compute comparison.
